description: local open data portals (Opendatasoft) is an open data portal listed in local open data portals (Opendatasoft), a federated catalogue of open data portals, published or maintained by Opendatasoft. The Opendatasoft hub federates the catalogues of about 400 public and private portals, most of them of French local authorities, energy operators and agencies. Datasets that many local portals re-publish from one national source are catalogued here as one record per source, not one per copy. Coverage: France and other countries served by Opendatasoft portals. 41,366 datasets are listed in the catalogue that this harvest read; 6 of them are about infrastructure and became records of their own. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is set per dataset on the portal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support finding infrastructure data published on local open data portals. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-syndicated-local-portals.
